title: onboard-lucida-13b-v1.0-perf-metadata-changelog-automation
author: Aisha Patel
description: Onboard lucida-13b v1.0 into the model registry with metadata, performance profiles and automated changelog generation. Context: Lucida is a 13B open-checkpoint we validated for latency/quality tradeoffs for chat and generation use-cases. Motivation: make Lucida available to customers and ensure reproducible perf data plus an automatic release note entry. Changes include: 1) models/lucida/metadata.json: model manifest (name, version, family, tokenization, license, commit hash, provenance links, recommended sequence lengths, default quantization profiles). 2) models/lucida/perf_profiles.yaml: throughput/latency profiles generated from perf-lab runs (batching configs, seq-length buckets, recommended kernel/quantization presets). 3) scripts/changelog/generate_lucida_entry.py: automation to append model onboarding entry to CHANGELOG.md and to the release-notes pipeline. 4) tests/model-registry/test_lucida_integration.py: lightweight validation asserting metadata schema and perf profile shape; uses offline fixtures. 5) docs/models.md: short blurb and build-time docs update. Checklist: - [x] Model manifest validated against registry schema - [x] Performance profiles produced from perf-lab runner - [x] Changelog automation unit tests added and passing - [x] Docs updated - [x] Security review (license/provenance) Notes: initial CI flake on unit test due to timezone-dependent fixture; fixed by normalizing timestamps in test fixture. Perf numbers attached were produced on perf-canary cluster id perf-2026-02-14 and are recorded in perf lab dashboard. Linear/PM: ENG-4123 for onboarding work, PM-218 for release coordination. Please review perf thresholds and manifest fields; I recommend enabling the automated changelog entry for the next release cycle.
